scope: Static review of current ACadRust AcDs regression tests and OpenCADStudio native/headless consumer automation, with emphasis on evidence level and a faster composed validation path.

method.kind: Primary project README, test source, automation guide, and current issue review
method.sourcePinning: GitHub main-branch source/docs and the issue were reviewed on 2026-10-15. The ACadRust README reports release 0.5.5; no peer binary or exact source commit was executed or pinned in this pass.
method.evidenceRule: Classify in-memory construction, same-library write/read, independent parser readback, kernel metrics, and target-native acceptance separately. A successful self-read or entity manifest does not establish exact ACIS semantics or AutoCAD compatibility.

findings.evidence: The current roundtrip test source uses minimal marker-bearing fake SAB data to check AcDs byte/body pairing and has_ds_data retention. A separate source-generated cube uses build_planar_body and the ACadRust R2018 writer/reader, but its visible assertions check a present 3DSOLID, has_data, and has_ds_data; they do not compare B-rep topology or analytic dimensions or invoke an independent parser/kernel.
findings.confidence: Static review of current source; no peer test was executed.
findings.planUse: Use structural fake-carrier tests only for container/link regressions. Keep a separate locally-authored known-shape manifest for semantic tests. Do not count peer-generated markers or same-library roundtrip as independent geometry evidence.

findings.evidence: The project documents native --serve/--mcp automation, target-version audit reporting including dropped_on_save and raw DXF reference checks, save_verified reopening and comparing the semantic entity manifest, build version/hash reporting, a script that emits DWG 2000/2013/2018 and DXF 2000, and a separate optional Windows reference-CAD AUDIT script. The documented manifest and internal readback are not stated to include exact B-rep metric comparison.
findings.confidence: Current primary repository documentation; no app build, tool or consumer run was performed.
findings.planUse: Offer an optional pinned-binary composed consumer check to reduce manual harness work. Capture build, target, hashes, lossy records, dangling refs, reopened body/entity counts and explicit NOT RUN states. Require independent geometry metrics and a distinct parser/target for stronger claims.

findings.evidence: The issue remained open on 2026-10-15. A user reported some app-produced 3D DWGs failed in AutoCAD or ProgeCAD. The maintainer reported improvement and a later pyramid/cylinder subtract that opened in an unnamed strict third-party DWG reader, while asking for a reproducible case for remaining issues. The report is mixed and does not establish current-build AutoCAD acceptance.
findings.confidence: Issue report and maintainer response; no files or claims independently reproduced.
findings.planUse: Treat OpenCADStudio as a candidate read/diagnostic route and possible distinct geometry-kernel lineage, but not the sole writer/native compatibility oracle. Pin exact build and require named target open/audit for emitted DWG.

readinessChanges: Keep the per-slice CI loop limited to generated fast tests, focused CTest, lc3_compat_check, strict warnings, and diff check.

At one composed AcDs/ACIS checkpoint, optionally reuse a pinned existing OpenCADStudio native binary's audit and verified-reopen operations; do not build/install it per slice or infer B-rep validity from its entity manifest.
Use source-generated body inputs with a known manifest and exact hashes. No peer fixture, external drawing, or runtime dependency is introduced.
Record parser and kernel lineages separately; ACadRust/OpenCADStudio same-library or shared-codec results do not count as two independent parser implementations.
